en: Sepia-toned photograph of a narrow, cobblestoned medieval street passing under a series of stone arches between old stone buildings. A person stands in the middle distance, while another sits in the left foreground. The architecture is vernacular Mediterranean, with rough stone walls, shuttered windows, and overhanging upper stories. The image looks like an old photographic postcard reproduction. A modern website watermark appears at the bottom right.
